title: Chapter 1035
text:
In the dream-like nebula, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy that had returned from the secondary dimension appeared before everyone's eyes.

This was an enormous mass of bright red energy. Its entire body was in the shape of a cloud, like a rolling cloud. Within it, grayish-white light that looked like ether lightning kept flashing. The energy in the center was the densest, and the density decreased toward the edges. At the periphery, the red energy danced like a thin veil. Upon closer inspection, this energy seemed to be made of tiny particles.

A large number of small red clusters of light danced around the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. These were the subsidiary bodies that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy had split and multiplied, like its descendants or servants. The one that Evans had bumped into before was one of them.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was a Primal Esper Ability Entity. It had an independent mind. Most of its consciousness and energy had been hibernating, and only a small portion of its instincts maintained its daily actions. It had given up on thinking and allowed itself to drift around.

This large patch of bright red was reflected in the eyes of the crew members of the various organizations through the portholes of every spaceship, illuminating the surprise and excitement in their eyes.

"It's out! It's out! Quick, do it! "

At this moment, all the organizations with their own agendas worked together to activate the spacetime stabilization traps that they had set up.

Buzz!

All the spacetime stabilization anchors, dimension isolators, reality enhancers, and other devices set up around them were all activated. Other than technology, all kinds of large magic rune arrays and space magic tools also started to take effect.

The explosive space energy spread out from different points like ripples, quickly smoothing out the 'wrinkles' in the space in the area. The spacetime coefficient was raised to an extremely stable level. Be it hyperdrive or wormhole, neither could be used here!

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was very sensitive to the changes in space. It instantly sensed the drastic changes in the environment it was in, and its consciousness was awakened. The enormous energy cloud suddenly shrank, and its body shrank rapidly. Its density expanded crazily, trying to turn into a black hole singularity and use its super high density to distort the spacetime coefficient and tear a gap in this trap.

The space in this area was like a piece of paper. The traps set up by the various organizations were like forces that pulled the paper straight. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's super high density was trying to exert force vertically in the middle of the paper, using a single point to break the surface and make the space wrinkle. The two forces were fighting against each other. If it were a normal piece of paper, it would have been pierced through under such resistance. However, this was a highly stabilized space that could not be destroyed.

Seeing this, a voice sounded in the public channel.

"Quickly absorb the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Its spacetime coefficient is falling. If it keeps resisting, it will break free from our space stabilization trap sooner or later!"

The next moment, a small fleet closest to it rushed toward the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, which had already turned into a blinding cluster of light. The outer armor at the front of the spaceship slid open, revealing a special mechanical device that released a shocking suction force toward the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy that targeted energy lifeforms. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy immediately vibrated slightly, and wisps of energy were sucked out of the cluster of light into the device like beams of light.

These organizations that came to fight for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy had all made early preparations. This was a device specifically used to contain and restrain energy life forms. Even if the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy condensed itself, its energy would still be sucked out. It was like a tug-of-war. It clenched its fist tightly, and the containment device tried to pry open its fingers.

However, at this time, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy suddenly shot out countless beams of light, bombarding this fleet.

The next second, the shield was penetrated, and the spaceship exploded, turning into fireworks in the universe. The fleet was completely annihilated in one round of attacks!

As the energy burst out, the psychic attribute of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was also activated. Waves of psychic currents with impactful properties were born and spread out. Everyone surrounding the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy suddenly felt dizzy, as if they were affected by infrasound waves.

In the dynasty fleet, Ravenlaude secretly curled his lips when he saw this.

"Heh, you're asking for death. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy is not something without risk."

Primal Esper Ability Entities were extremely ancient. They were a cluster of energy in themselves. Without a host, they could unleash their abilities through extensive means, such as directly shooting out energy.

At this time, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy turned around and fled, flying at super high speed like a meteor. The surrounding fleets immediately revealed their containment devices and chased after it.

"I'll do it!"

Ravenlaude's eyes sparkled. He left the battleship and chased after it at high speed under the effect of magic while casting spells rapidly.

Runes surrounded him one after another, shining with arcane light. Dense magic energy pulled at the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, greatly reducing its speed. At the same time, waves of arcane energy were injected into the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and turned into magic runes controlled by Ravenlaude. They mixed foreign energy into the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to weaken its control over its body.

The effect was obvious. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could no longer maintain its condensed state. The cluster of light quickly exploded and expanded into a cluster of energy cloud. The range of the attack immediately increased by countless times.

Beyond Grade A Mages often traveled in secondary dimensions, so Ravenlaude was very experienced in dealing with energy entities. He easily blocked the energy beams that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy countered without caring about the cost with his Spell Shield.

Seeing that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was gradually falling into Ravenlaude's control, a surge of psychic energy suddenly swept out from behind him.

Ravenlaude narrowed his eyes, diverted some of his attention, and used a defensive spell to block the psychic attack behind him. Not far away, a figure passed him and flew toward the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, holding a high-end portable energy object container in his hand.

"Humph, Sisko."

Without saying anything, Ravenlaude also attacked Sisko. The two of them fought while chasing after the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, dragging each other down.

Seeing this, some organizations wanted to take advantage of the situation. However, the spaceships that got close to the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy were all shattered into pieces by the 'shockwaves' from the battle between Beyond Grade As.

The two Beyond Grade As kept fighting, magic and psychic energy clashed again and again. The scene was very intense. Ravenlaude had the upper hand and suppressed Sisko's attacks. However, although the battle was intense, the two of them did not go all out. They did not forget to save some energy to store the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Under the pincer attack of two Beyond Grade As, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could not do much. Seals merged into its body one after another, and its resistance became weaker and weaker. Gradually, it showed signs of being completely sealed and stored.

At the same time, the Modo Civilization's troops were also patrolling around the edge of the battlefield. The dozens of Calamity Grades on the ship stared at the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy with serious expressions as they discussed in low voices.

"Guys, the two of them are holding each other back. Should we attack now?"

"The chance is too small. Even with dozens of Calamity Grades working together, we can only block the attacks of the two of them for a while. There's not enough time for us to retreat. We'll definitely have to sacrifice a lot of lives. It's not worth it."

Everyone looked at each other and shook their heads.

Their superiors told them to act according to the situation, but there was no chance. Although these Calamity Grades were usually arrogant, they did not have the confidence to face a Beyond Grade A. Even if they were very loyal to the Modo Civilization, no one wanted to die for nothing.

In the communication channel, Roddick was silent for a while before he said with a deep voice, "If there's no chance, then forget it. Don't force your way in."

Hearing this, the dozens of Calamity Grades on the ship relaxed their tense bodies and heaved a sigh of relief.

Roddick was a little unwilling, but he was not too stubborn about it. The original goal of sending out so many Calamity Grades was to obtain an absolute advantage without any Beyond Grade As.

However, with the intervention of a Beyond Grade A, the mission was basically a failure. Since they could not do it, the best choice was to retreat. There was no need to let the Calamity Grades of the civilization die.

This is just a side mission. There's no need to force it. Facing such a situation, the upper echelons will understand. If a large number of elites are sacrificed for this, the upper echelons will blame it on me.

Thinking of this, Roddick said loudly, "Guys, let's retreat!"

"Okay!" Everyone responded happily.

However, the next moment, something unexpected happened!

The Modo Civilization's fleet suddenly turned around and charged straight at the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Not only that, they even opened fire and launched a surprise attack on Ravenlaude and Sisko!

At this moment, everyone present was shocked.

Even the battle between Ravenlaude and Sisko stopped. They had no choice but to block this surprise attack. Both of them were a little stunned.

You … you're actually firing at us?

There's such a brave warrior?

In the command center of the base, Roddick's expression changed drastically. He said furiously, "What are you doing? You're crazy! "

"Our spaceship is suddenly not listening to us!" The Calamity Grades were shocked.

Roddick suddenly thought of something, and his face turned pale.

This strong sense of déjà vu …

Virtual Intrusion?

"B * stard, it's happening again!"

Roddick was shocked and furious. He was about to yell for everyone to run.

However, at this moment, the remote communication connection was directly cut off. The screen turned black, and his face twisted in anger was reflected.

"Black Star!"

Bang!

Roddick roared and smashed the communicator. The room was instantly filled with the air of powerlessness and fury.

The Modo Civilization, who was the third party, instantly gained the aggro of the Modo Civilization. Ravenlaude and Sisko even stopped fighting each other temporarily. Magic waves and psychic storms smashed into the Modo Civilization's troops, and the small fleet they brought was quickly destroyed.

The dozens of Calamity Grades were terrified. They immediately escaped from the spaceship and scattered. However, Ravenlaude and Sisko did not have the habit of letting people who ambushed them go. They chased after them.

The Calamity Grades that the Modo Civilization spent a lot of effort to cultivate and recruit could only block a few attacks at most. Very soon, they died one after another.

The difference between a Beyond Grade A and a Calamity Grade was like a chasm. These people had no way of fighting back and could only run for their lives.

More than eighty percent of the dozens of Calamity Grades died. Only then did Ravenlaude and Sisko stop and start fighting each other again.

This result shocked the other organizations. They all retreated with their fleets, no longer daring to fight for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy with the two of them.

The dynasty's fleet was not idle. They were exchanging fire with the Star Pupil God Race's fleet. In terms of spaceship technology and scale, the dynasty was stronger. The Star Pupil God Race's fleet was forced to retreat.

"You still want to fight with me?" Ravenlaude raised his eyebrows and said calmly with a spell, "We can fight for a few more days and nights, but your fleet will probably be wiped out. I heard you value your people a lot. How about it? Is the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy worth so many lives?"

Sisko unleashed a tornado-like psychic energy and shattered the Arcane Fission Bomb. He clenched his teeth and said, "You think you can make me give up with just a few words? Your dynasty's fleet will also suffer quite a lot of losses! "

"That's right, but those are the dynasty's soldiers. I don't care about casualties." Ravenlaude did not care. "You can't win against me. Don't make unnecessary sacrifices. As long as we absorb the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and get someone to remove the spacetime stabilization trap, I can open a portal and leave the battlefield instantly. You're just a Psychic. Can you catch up?"

Sisko's expression was uncertain. He suddenly stopped and stopped fighting with Ravenlaude. He turned around to support the fleet and beat back the dynasty's fleet.

Seeing this, Ravenlaude knew that Sisko had given up and smiled in satisfaction. Without anyone stopping him, he cast sealing spells with all his might. Endless arcane light entered the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Very soon, a magic shield covered the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and quickly shrunk. It was completely sealed in the magic crystal ball that Ravenlaude took out.

"Success!"

Ravenlaude's eyes sparkled. It was as if he saw the Universal Treasure promised by the dynasty waving at him.

Before he could rejoice, the moment the seal was completed, a powerful Mind Magic that had been charged up for a long time suddenly attacked him and hit his mental barrier. Ravenlaude's mind was shaken, and he fell into a temporary dizzy spell.

At the same time, a figure suddenly flew out of an ordinary spaceship and approached Ravenlaude at high speed. He cast spells along the way, and magic circles quickly formed around Ravenlaude. Countless blue tentacles of magic power formed from the magic circles and tightly bound Ravenlaude's body.

This was not a simple binding spell. The official name of this spell was [Arrival of Atomte — Chaos Magic Tentacles]. It was a set of top-level spells that had the effect of silencing a Mage's magic for a short period of time. It also had the effect of binding one's soul. Once bound, the Mage would be in a stiffened state for a longer period of time and would not be able to control their body.

Not far away, Sisko sensed the sudden burst of energy and turned around with shock. "There's another Beyond Grade A?"

This time, Ravenlaude finally recovered from the stunned state. Shocked, he hastily tried to break free from the binding.

However, this figure had already arrived beside him. He snatched the magic sphere container that sealed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and pressed his palm on Ravenlaude's chest.

Dense magic energy gushed out and turned into a thick purple-blue pillar of light, blasting Ravenlaude far away.

This attack did not deal much damage. Ravenlaude flew a short distance away and quickly stabilized himself. He looked up in shock and anger. Seeing this figure full of tattoos, his expression froze.

"It's you, Secret Master!"

The circle was not big, and all the famous Beyond Grade As knew each other. Secret Master's position in the circle was even higher than his.

Secret Master had an indifferent expression. He ignored Ravenlaude, who was both furious and fearful. He looked down at the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, nodded, and said without changing his expression, "Thank you for helping me with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

"Thank you for helping me store the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. I let you keep it for a few seconds. Now, it's back to its owner."

Ravenlaude was so angry that he laughed. "I thought Black Star was the most shameless among the Beyond Grade As. I didn't expect you to be so strong as well. Why is it returned to its owner? Since when are you the owner of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy?"

"I'm here. It's mine," Secret Master said coldly.

Ravenlaude choked and said angrily, "Stop talking nonsense. Do you think you can get away?"

It was not easy to get a chance to exchange for a Universal Treasure. Even if Secret Master was stronger, Ravenlaude would not give up so easily.

Secret Master glanced at him and said expressionlessly, "I can leave if I want to."

As soon as he said that, a large piece of the space stabilization trap in this area suddenly disappeared, and a part of it suddenly exploded. When he was setting up the trap, Secret Master had already secretly done something to it. He planted invisible explosive runes that could be remotely controlled so that he could create an environment where his teleportation spell would take effect after he succeeded.

The spacetime stability coefficient plummeted, and the effect of the trap plummeted. It would not be able to counter the space magic of a Beyond Grade A Super. Ravenlaude's expression changed drastically. He immediately understood Secret Master's intention and hurriedly started chanting, trying to use space spells to stop Secret Master's teleportation.

However, Secret Master was even faster. As his blue magic surged, he had already created the spell model of the teleportation gate. He activated it instantly, and a blue vortex quickly formed beside him.

Seeing Ravenlaude quickly approach him, Secret Master's face was calm, and his expression did not change at all.

"See you next time, Ra … hmm?"

Before he finished his sentence, he suddenly felt his hand sink. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy seal container in his hand was gone, replaced by a mechanical arm connected to a humanoid mechanical body whose eyes were flashing with blue and gold lightning. The mechanical body appeared next to him without warning.

"You …" Secret Master's eyes flickered, and shock finally appeared on his face.

This mechanical body tilted its head and suddenly shook. A strange Void Energy suddenly spread out and covered a large area, including Ravenlaude.

The next moment, Secret Master and Ravenlaude both realized that the space in this area had become viscous, and their movements had uncontrollably slowed down.

Void Prison!

Ravenlaude immediately thought of the owner of this ability and blurted out, "Black Star?"

Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar turned around and glanced at him. He smiled and said, "Yo, you recognize me?"

"You came at the right time!" Ravenlaude was overjoyed. He thought that Han Xiao was a secret reinforcement called by the dynasty.

Han Xiao saw through his thoughts immediately and shook his head. "I'm not here for the dynasty."

Hearing this, Ravenlaude's smile froze.

He immediately understood that Black Star was different from him. He was not here to get the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy for the dynasty but for himself.

In that case, although Black Star was the dynasty's ally, he was his competitor in this matter.

Understanding this, Ravenlaude's heart skipped a beat.

At the same time, Secret Master narrowed his eyes. Frustrated that all his efforts had gone to waste, he coldly said, "Black Star, you stole my Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy?"

Han Xiao turned to look at him and smiled.

"I'll use your words … thank you for keeping it safe for me for a few seconds."

He had already made arrangements here. His Lord's Avatar hid nearby with his mechanical army and watched the entire battle. He also tricked the Modo Civilization to complete the mission.

When Secret Master broke the spacetime stabilization trap and was about to leave, his Lord's Avatar finally found the opportunity and used [Void Swap] to switch places with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy sealing ritual instrument. This way, the sealing ritual instrument fell into the hands of the mechanical army.

However, this way, the energy fluctuation caused the camouflage to fail, and the mechanical army was exposed. In order to prevent the two of them from chasing after him, his Lord's Avatar directly activated the Void Prison and temporarily restrained Secret Master and Ravenlaude so that the mechanical army could escape with the sealing ritual instrument.

As long as they returned to the safe zone, they would have succeeded.

The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind. Secret Master thought that he was the oriole, but what he did not know was that Han Xiao hid even deeper than he did.

"The only problem is …"

Han Xiao turned to look at Sisko in the distance. This guy was not trapped by the Void Prison and had the ability to chase after him.

Sensing Han Xiao's gaze, Sisko's expression was extremely ugly.

This time, the voice of the Star Pupil Protoss officer sounded in the psychic communication network.

"Leader, we detected a mechanical army that suddenly appeared and is escaping with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Should we chase after them?"

"No, retreat!"

Seeing Han Xiao, Sisko did not hesitate and turned around to leave.

He did not want to have a direct confrontation with Black Star at all, so he was very decisive in his decision.

More importantly, even if Black Star's mechanical army did not have his Lord's Avatar, he felt that he might not be able to beat it …

He's actually so smart?

Han Xiao could not help but scratch his head and chuckle. He then looked at Secret Master, who had an ugly expression and was filled with hostility, and cracked his neck.

"I'll gladly accept the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. If you're not happy … how about I help you loosen your bones?"
